description: Add a product to the user's cart. Args: good_id (from search/get_product), size (must be one of the product's sizes), fabric? (if the product offers a choice), qty? (default 1). Returns the updated cart.

fabric.description: Fabric label from get_product, if the product offers a choice.

size.description: Size label; must be one of the product's available sizes.

name: add_to_cart

checkout_url.description: Cart page URL for the human.

error.description: Present instead of a cart when the call failed (bad index, unavailable size, ...).

items.description: Cart lines in index order — this index is what update_cart_item takes.

custom.description: True when the line is a user-generated custom print.

subtotal.description: Sum of price x qty over all lines, USD.

title: Add to cart
